answer: The delta multiplier is published, charged in meadow, and inlet lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 14 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 2554 identities would post 1808 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
